title: ping_l2: loopback packet-path wait times out after TX capacity fix
description: Follow-up from 5fva.1. After commit 237dc35064 (frame_len capacity fix) + 84908feee9 (re-provision + drop legacy link key), test_full_l2_loopback_ping advances past all frame-build errors: TX frames now build and transmit, but wait_for_packet_path times out after 10s — the RX side of the loopback path (lichen_lora_l2 loopback RX -> lichen_l2_input -> ping reply -> TX) is never observed. Debug the loopback RX pipeline on native_sim (heft): radio loopback driver delivers TX frame to RX callback? SCHC decompress + replay + peer auth on the reply path? Logs show no RX frame delivered within the wait window. Partial state: suite now 4/7 (was 3/7 at start of chain).
